# BiteKrakow

> Independent, editor-written guide to where locals eat and drink in Kraków, Poland: cafes, restaurants and bars by cuisine and neighborhood, with real addresses, opening hours, prices and what to order. Every place is visited in person and paid for. Nobody pays to be included and nobody can pay to be removed. Published in English, with Arabic (/ar/) and Polish (/pl/) editions of the key guides.

Two kinds of ratings appear on the site and are kept separate: an editorial score out of 10 written by the editor after visits, and Google's star rating with review count, pulled live and labelled as Google. Each guide carries the date its details were last checked. Permanently closed venues are removed.

## How the site works
- [How We Test: The BiteKrakow Method](https://bitekrakow.com/how-we-test/): How BiteKrakow works: every place visited in person and paid for, no sponsored rankings, our score kept apart from Google's, every guide dated.
- [About BiteKrakow and Cezary Musiał](https://bitekrakow.com/about/): BiteKrakow is an independent guide to Krakow's food and coffee scene, written and edited by Cezary Musiał. No sponsored rankings, every place visited in person.
- [All guides](https://bitekrakow.com/guides/): every guide in one place, by topic, cuisine and neighborhood.
- [Food map](https://bitekrakow.com/map/): the city district by district, with the top pick in each.
- [All places](https://bitekrakow.com/restaurants/): every venue we cover, grouped by district.
